# sfl2

The SoundFont synthesis engine from [SFLT](https://estrobiologist.gumroad.com/l/sflt) by ash taylor ([estroBiologist](https://github.com/estroBiologist)), copied from the source included with SFLT beta 0.9.0 for macOS. GPL-3.0 (`LICENSE.txt`).

The first commit that adds this folder is the unmodified original. Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) has since modified it for sfz123 for Oliver2213; the changes are listed in sfz123's README under "How it is built".
